description: This file defines a utility function 'isPromiseLike' that checks whether a given value conforms to the Promise-like interface.

methods.name: export function isPromiseLike<T>(value: unknown): value is PromiseLike<T> { isPromiseLike
methods.description: Type guard function that determines whether a given value is Promise-like by checking for the presence of a 'then' method.

calls: value && (typeof value === "object" || typeof value === "function") && "then" in value && typeof (value as { then?: unknown }).then === "function"
